headline: Council advances hotel rezoning for some apartment-zoned properties

meeting.voteItem: Committee Report 26-54 recommending first reading of Bill 95-2026
meeting.summary: The council adopted two hotel rezoning resolutions for apartment-zoned properties, each 7–1, and backed a first-look home resale bill proposal.
meeting.recap: A testifier for the Office of Hawaiian Affairs opposed Resolutions 26-110 and 26-111.[[0:28:42]] The council voted 8–0 to advance Bill 95-2026, which aims to increase Maui bus ridership, on first reading.[[1:06:21]] Council staff said the council could act only on properties listed on the meeting agenda.[[1:34:07]] The council voted 8–0 for a state bill proposal giving owner-occupants, community land trusts and nonprofits a first look at single-family home resales.[[2:19:09]] Seven proposed charter amendments came up for a final vote for the next general election ballot.[[2:22:04]] The charter amendment motion carried with eight ayes and one member excused.[[2:24:22]]
decided: The council adopted the committee report advancing Bill 95-2026, which expands fare-free bus pass eligibility, on first reading.
The resolution was referred to the Government Relations, Ethics, and Transparency Committee with no objections.
The resolution was referred to the Water and Infrastructure Committee.
The council passed a bill updating Park Maui paid and permit parking zones on second and final reading.
meeting.next: Council staff said future resolutions could be introduced to add properties to H3 and H4 zoning. The seven charter amendments are to go before voters at the next general election.

moments.q: Office of Hawaiian Affairs testimony against the rezoning resolutions
